standard_types.name: Business Rule
standard_types.description: One standing business rule, constraint, invariant, or policy

standard_types.name: Question
standard_types.description: One named unknown, with what is known, what is missing, and what would close it

standard_types.name: Request
standard_types.description: A durable request from any relevant source

standard_types.name: Analysis
standard_types.description: An investigation, feasibility study, comparison, or recommendation

standard_types.name: Decision
standard_types.description: A durable non-architectural decision with an independent lifecycle

standard_types.name: Architecture Decision Record
standard_types.description: An architectural decision in ADR form

standard_types.name: Architecture Document
standard_types.description: A durable description of the system architecture

standard_types.name: Specification
standard_types.description: A specification the project maintains as durable knowledge, not one a tracker owns the state of

standard_types.name: Interaction Record
standard_types.description: An interaction whose combined context is itself durable

standard_types.name: Attested Computation
standard_types.description: An OKF-defined sanctioned computation with a checkable execution receipt

relationships.name: superseded-by
relationships.description: This concept has been replaced by the target

relationships.name: depends-on
relationships.description: This concept is only valid while the target holds

relationships.name: constrained-by
relationships.description: The target limits what this concept may do

relationships.name: part-of
relationships.description: This concept is a constituent of the target, which is incomplete without it

relationships.name: refines
relationships.description: This concept narrows or sharpens the target

relationships.name: specified-by
relationships.description: The target is the specification of this concept

relationships.name: implemented-by
relationships.description: The target is the work that delivers this concept

relationships.name: resolves
relationships.description: This concept fully answers or closes the target

relationships.name: partially-resolves
relationships.description: This concept answers part of the target, which remains open

relationships.name: tracked-by
relationships.description: The target is the work-tracking record that chases this concept
